summary: Frontend testing of SlotNow web app iteration 2 (new features: provider onboarding + dashboard, PIN re-login, booking reschedule, i18n EN/HI, automobile-specific booking fields, live queue polling). Confirmed PASSING: (1) role toggle + OTP + set-PIN prompt + skip/save, (2) full i18n Hindi/English switch reflected on Home/Bookings/Notifications/Profile, (3) PIN login (accepts phone + 4-digit PIN and authenticates), (4) route protection both directions, (5) provider onboarding form + navigation to dashboard, (6) provider services CRUD (add + remove), (7) provider availability add (rule appears), (8) logout via in-app modal. TWO P0 REGRESSIONS DISCOVERED: (a) BookSlot.jsx crashes with 't is not a function' — the file uses t()/isAutomobile/vehicleReg/vehicleModel/serviceType/Car but NEVER destructures useI18n() nor declares those states nor imports Car icon. Blocks 100% of customer booking creation, and by extension blocks Automobile fields test, Reschedule test (no fresh bookings can be created), and Live-queue polling test (no active booking detail reachable). (b) ProviderQueue.jsx crashes with 'queue.filter is not a function' — assumes /queue/today returns an array but the provider-role response is not an array; needs Array.isArray guard. Blocks Call Next / Walk-in / Reset queue view entirely.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash 'TypeError: t is not a function' immediately on mount. Root cause: file uses t(...) for i18n strings (lines 203, 207, 235, 241, 252, 259, 266, 273, etc.) but the component NEVER destructures `const { t } = useI18n();` and does not import useI18n from '@/i18n'. Additionally, the states referenced by the Automobile section (isAutomobile, vehicleReg, vehicleModel, serviceType, setVehicleReg, setVehicleModel, setServiceType) are never declared, and the `Car` lucide icon used at line 251 is not in the import statement on line 6. This is a P0 regression from iteration 1 — customers cannot create ANY booking, including the required automobile-fields flow.

Runtime crash 'TypeError: queue.filter is not a function' on /provider/queue. Root cause: load() does `setQueue(qRes.data || [])` where /queue/today for a provider returns a non-array (likely wrapped object or error). The subsequent `queue.filter(...)` at line 88 explodes. Needs `setQueue(Array.isArray(qRes.data) ? qRes.data : (qRes.data?.items || qRes.data?.queue || []))` or defensive filter. Blocks Call Next, Walk-in modal, Reset queue.

React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The category <option> renders a translated label wrapped in a <span> (via dynamic template) which is invalid HTML. Rendering works but log spam and potential hydration issue in production.
Emergent floating badge continues to overlap bottom-nav Notifications/Profile pills on mobile viewport (400x900). Reported in iteration_1 and NOT yet fixed.

integration_issues.issue: After a successful PIN login, the app landed on /profile instead of / (Home). Likely because pinLogin does not force-navigate to '/' or '/provider' based on role, leaving the router on the previous path. Cosmetic but confusing for users.

Could not be validated end-to-end because BookSlot is broken (cannot create fresh bookings) and no existing upcoming bookings remained on the customer account. Reschedule modal testids exist in code (reschedule-date-*, reschedule-time-*, reschedule-confirm-btn) but the flow could not be exercised.

Selecting only Monday (avail-day-1) + 09:00-18:00 + 30 min + Add resulted in SEVEN avail-rule-* items in the list. Either default availability was pre-created on onboarding for all 7 days, or the add call created rules for all days regardless of selected checkbox. Needs verification.

action_items: CRITICAL P0: Fix BookSlot.jsx — add `import { useI18n } from '@/i18n'` and `const { t } = useI18n();`, add the missing state hooks `const [vehicleReg,setVehicleReg]=useState(''); const [vehicleModel,setVehicleModel]=useState(''); const [serviceType,setServiceType]=useState('');`, add `const isAutomobile = provider?.category_id === '333a2602-2d4a-4e16-a9da-3e004b0e14fd';`, and add `Car` to the lucide-react import. Verify booking creation works end-to-end before any further iteration.

CRITICAL P0: Fix ProviderQueue.jsx line 25 — guard against non-array: `setQueue(Array.isArray(qRes.data) ? qRes.data : (qRes.data?.queue || qRes.data?.items || []))`. Also add `.catch(() => ({ data: [] }))` on the /queue/today call.
HIGH: Fix bottom-nav overlap with 'Made with Emergent' badge (carried over from iter1; still unresolved).
MEDIUM: Fix PIN-login post-nav — after pinLogin success, navigate to '/' for customer role and '/provider' for provider role (mirror OTP verify handler).
MEDIUM: Verify provider availability add — one day selected should not create 7 rules.
LOW: Fix ProviderOnboarding category option to render translated label as plain text (not wrapped in <span>) to eliminate hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: BookSlot.jsx: severe integration miss — the Automobile-fields feature was written but the state, i18n hook, and icon import were never added. Must have missed the diff. Every render crashes. Suggests iteration 2 was not smoke-tested locally before commit.

ProviderQueue.jsx: no defensive handling around API response shape. Any endpoint that returns an object instead of a list will crash the page. Add Array.isArray guards site-wide (also ProviderDashboard.jsx line 40 has the same pattern).
i18n integration is solid — dictionary covers Home/Bookings/Notifications/Profile labels in Hindi and switching persists across route changes.
Onboarding UX: after save the app correctly navigates to /provider dashboard and RequireRole redirects work.
Consider central error boundary — currently a single component crash yields the raw dev error overlay rather than a graceful fallback.

success_rate.frontend: 9 of 13 requested feature flows verified passing (69%). 2 flows are blocked by BookSlot/ProviderQueue P0 crashes: automobile fields, reschedule, live polling, walk-in modal / call-next / reset queue. All new testids that could be exercised were found.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes BookSlot.jsx and ProviderQueue.jsx, re-run: (1) create a customer booking (any provider), (2) open its detail and test booking-reschedule-btn → reschedule-date-* → reschedule-time-* → reschedule-confirm-btn; (3) create an Automobile-category booking (provider id 333a2602-2d4a-4e16-a9da-3e004b0e14fd) and verify booking-vehicle-reg is required + saved and shown on booking detail; (4) on booking detail, use network interception to count /api/queue/my-position requests over 10s visible (expect 2-3) and 10s hidden (expect 0); (5) log in as provider 8888800884 with OTP 123456, go to /provider/queue and verify queue-call-next-btn/queue-walkin-btn/queue-reset-btn work and walk-in modal (walkin-name → walkin-add-btn) creates a queue-item. Existing provider user_id (Sharma Clinic) can also be used if backend seed persists.
rca of the issue: BookSlot.jsx: the diff for iteration 2's Automobile feature added JSX referencing t(...), isAutomobile, vehicleReg/vehicleModel/serviceType and the Car icon, but the corresponding hook (`const { t } = useI18n()`), state declarations, `const isAutomobile = provider?.category_id === '333a2602-...'`, and lucide-react `Car` import were omitted. Because these variables are undefined at render time, the first t() call throws 'TypeError: t is not a function' and the entire page unmounts to the dev error overlay. ProviderQueue.jsx: the /queue/today API response for a provider does not match the assumed shape (array). `setQueue(qRes.data || [])` accepts an object as truthy; the subsequent `.filter` at line 88 explodes. Both are simple two-line fixes but must be applied before iteration 2 can be considered complete.
